about: What a plugin's needs may name, and the capability and trust each feature permission needs. Kept in contracts/capabilities.json of the EmuDEN repository, whose tests check it against the app, and copied to schema/capabilities.json of emuden-plugins, which plugin_tool.py reads.

capabilities.name: engine.libretro
capabilities.meaning: Games run in a libretro core inside EmuDEN

capabilities.name: engine.switch2
capabilities.meaning: The Switch 2 engine; EmuDEN's own plugins only

capabilities.name: content.multi_file
capabilities.meaning: content.multi_file: disc games of several files

capabilities.name: content.magic
capabilities.meaning: content.magic: bytes that tell whose file a shared extension is

capabilities.name: presentation.buttons
capabilities.meaning: presentation.buttons: the names of the console's own buttons

capabilities.name: presentation.screens
capabilities.meaning: presentation.screens: a picture of several screens (a system's or a core's)

capabilities.name: core.netplay
capabilities.meaning: A core's netplay: how it plays together with another device

capabilities.name: core.tuning
capabilities.meaning: A core's tuning: core option values chosen by device

capabilities.name: core.engine-app.1
capabilities.meaning: A core of type engine-app: an emulator app that speaks the Emulator Control Protocol

capabilities.name: feature.web.1
capabilities.meaning: den.web: sites of browse_hosts in the app's browser page

capabilities.name: feature.browser.1
capabilities.meaning: The browser for any site and the setup of its downloads

capabilities.name: feature.mods.1
capabilities.meaning: den.mods: files in the folders of Steam games and Vulkan layers; EmuDEN's own plugins only

capabilities.name: kind.interface
capabilities.meaning: An interface plugin (a look for Home)
